cc:Work.dc:title: Compiler source-to-artifact comparison
cc:Work.dc:description: Fresh compiler process per build; retained OS caches; Goose -O2. One unmeasured warmup per cell, followed by shuffled balanced rounds. Front-end bars end after Wasm/C emission; C compiler and golden-output execution run only after the timed campaign. C++ is a benchmark competitor, never an oracle. No Zig compiler is measured.
